problemStatement: Traditional paper-based ordering and manual bill calculation led to service bottlenecks during peak hours, frequent order mistakes, and a lack of centralized sales statistics.
coreFeatures: Kitchen POS Screen: Instant real-time order notifications via SignalR Hub
Custom Menu Ordering: Dynamic noodle choices, spiciness levels, and add-on toppings
Automated PromptPay Payment: Dynamic QR code with slip verification workflow
Analytics Dashboard: Daily/monthly sales breakdowns and top-selling menu graphs
architectureHighlights: Decoupled 4-layer Clean Architecture (Controllers, Services, Repositories, Models) with Unit Testing support.
18+ DTO objects with AutoMapper to prevent data model leaks and maintain clean API contracts.
EF Core query optimization utilizing .AsNoTracking(), Eager Loading, and .AsSplitQuery() on joined queries.
Real-time SignalR Hub broadcasting new orders directly to kitchen screens without browser refresh.
businessImpact: Eliminated manual billing calculation errors, reduced kitchen miscommunication, and provided restaurant owners with real-time sales visibility.

deepDive.overview: An end-to-end point-of-sale and restaurant management platform built to handle real-time customer ordering, kitchen queues, and financial reporting with transactional consistency.

Parameterized SQL queries generated via EF Core preventing SQL Injection exploits.

title: Used Car Community Management Platform (ระบบรถยนต์มือสองตำบลหนองกุ่ม)

metrics.label: Duplicate Bookings

metrics.detail: Polly Retry Policies on background reservation cleanup

metrics.label: Idempotent Payments
metrics.detail: Stripe Webhook signature verification preventing double charge

problemStatement: Used car trade in local communities relied entirely on informal word-of-mouth with scattered data, lack of vehicle history verification, and no secure booking deposit system.
coreFeatures: Smart Vehicle Search: Filtering and comparison by make, model, price with server-side pagination
Installment Calculator: Instant loan estimate calculator and vehicle maintenance history tracking
Stripe Booking & Deposit: Secure booking deposit with automated countdown queue cancellation
Seller KYC Verification: Strict seller identity verification and admin approval workflows
architectureHighlights: Decoupled 3-layer Clean Architecture with Generic Repository Pattern minimizing redundant code.
Automated BackgroundService (ReservationExpiryWorker) utilizing Polly Retry Policies.
Stripe Webhooks with Idempotency Checks to guarantee zero duplicate payment charges.
Filtered Unique Index on database level preventing concurrent duplicate bookings on the same vehicle.
businessImpact: Created a transparent, verifiable marketplace for community dealers and buyers, cutting search time by 60% and ensuring secure escrow deposits.

deepDive.overview: A digital marketplace and management platform connecting rural car sellers and buyers with verified KYC, smart installment calculation, and Stripe-powered escrow bookings.

Identity verification (KYC) requirements before vehicle listings are publicly visible.

title: SBFblazor: E-Commerce & Inventory Management Platform

metrics.label: Schema Leakage
metrics.detail: Strict DTO abstraction hiding database models from WASM client

problemStatement: Inaccurate stock updates led to customers purchasing out-of-stock items, manual bank transfer validation slowed down fulfillment, and daily sales auditing was cumbersome.
coreFeatures: Real-time Stock Sync: Immediate inventory deduction on order placement preventing overselling
Single-Page Cart & Checkout: Streamlined product selection, checkout, and order status tracking
Stripe Payment Gateway: Secure credit card processing with idempotency verification
Financial Reports & Export: Automated daily/monthly sales reports exported to PDF and Excel
architectureHighlights: Hybrid Blazor architecture: Blazor WebAssembly for rapid client storefront and Blazor Server for admin stability.
Pessimistic Concurrency row-locking during checkout to prevent race conditions during high-volume purchases.
Resilient integration with payment gateways using Polly Retry Policies for transient timeouts.
Strict DTO data transfer ensuring sensitive entity fields are never exposed to browser memory.
businessImpact: Eliminated 100% of inventory overselling incidents, shortened checkout settlement time, and automated financial spreadsheet generation.

deepDive.overview: An integrated enterprise e-commerce platform combining Blazor WebAssembly for fast shopping and Blazor Server for robust inventory management and accounting exports.
